subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
[NAT]
A counter sequence is given as: 
3 – 2 – 1 – 4 – 6 – 3 – - - - - -  
If its starting state is (100)2 then after application of 
1049 clock pulses, counter will be at __(__)10___.
explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-09 (Sequential Circuits (Part- 2)).
